about:
# 🇬🇧 PatchToolsMaps

_Your world map, with more freedom. The map module for PatchTools, for Classic Era and Forever._

## Features

- Move and resize the world map
- Zoom in further with the mouse wheel
- Choose how unexplored areas appear
- Remember your preferred position and size for each character
- Adjust map transparency
- A modern frame with player and cursor coordinates
- Keep supported addon buttons and buff timers outside the map
- Switch back to the classic frame whenever you prefer

Adjust everything through the PatchTools settings. Right-click the zone name in the modern frame for quick access to map transparency.

The modern frame supports Classic Era and Forever.

**[PatchTools](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/patchtools) is required and must be enabled!**

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `/ptmaps` | Open the Map settings in PatchTools. |
| `/ptmaps reset` | Reset the map’s position, size and zoom. |
| `/ptmaps status` | Open copyable map information for troubleshooting. |
| `/ptmaps debug` | Open the shared diagnostic report with addon versions and load states. |

You can also use `/patchtoolsmaps` instead of `/ptmaps`.

[Source code](https://github.com/csBlackWolf/PatchToolsMaps) · [Report bugs and suggest ideas](https://github.com/csBlackWolf/PatchTools/issues/new/choose)

[User guide](https://github.com/csBlackWolf/PatchToolsMaps/blob/main/GUIDE.md) · [Developer guide](https://github.com/csBlackWolf/PatchToolsMaps/blob/main/DEVELOPMENT.md)

# 🇩🇪 PatchToolsMaps

_Deine Weltkarte mit mehr Freiheiten. Das Kartenmodul für PatchTools, für Classic Era und Forever._

## Funktionen

- Die Weltkarte frei verschieben und ihre Größe ändern
- Mit dem Mausrad weiter hineinzoomen
- Die Darstellung unentdeckter Gebiete selbst wählen
- Position und Größe für jeden Charakter merken
- Die Kartentransparenz anpassen
- Moderner Rahmen mit Spieler- und Mauskoordinaten
- Unterstützte Addon-Buttons und Buff-Timer außerhalb der Karte platzieren
- Bei Bedarf jederzeit zum klassischen Rahmen wechseln

Alles bequem in den PatchTools-Einstellungen anpassen. Per Rechtsklick auf den Gebietsnamen im modernen Rahmen erreichst du die Kartentransparenz auch direkt.

Der moderne Rahmen unterstützt Classic Era und Forever.

**[PatchTools](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/patchtools) wird benötigt und muss aktiviert sein!**

## Befehle

| Befehl | Funktion |
| --- | --- |
| `/ptmaps` | Die Karteneinstellungen in PatchTools öffnen. |
| `/ptmaps reset` | Position, Größe und Zoom der Karte zurücksetzen. |
| `/ptmaps status` | Kopierbare Karteninformationen zur Fehlersuche öffnen. |
| `/ptmaps debug` | Den gemeinsamen Diagnosebericht mit Addon-Versionen und Ladestatus öffnen. |

Statt `/ptmaps` funktioniert auch `/patchtoolsmaps`.

[Quellcode](https://github.com/csBlackWolf/PatchToolsMaps) · [Fehler und Ideen melden](https://github.com/csBlackWolf/PatchTools/issues/new/choose)

[Bedienungsanleitung](https://github.com/csBlackWolf/PatchToolsMaps/blob/main/GUIDE.md) · [Entwicklerinfos](https://github.com/csBlackWolf/PatchToolsMaps/blob/main/DEVELOPMENT.md)

releases.name: PatchToolsMaps 0.3.4
releases.notes:
# PatchToolsMaps 0.3.4 — 2026-11-13

- Keep unexplored-area previews available after client patches using the last matching map data. Temporarily outdated previews no longer require a new release just to enable them again.
- Restore reliable map transparency and a smooth slider preview without the setting being overwritten.
- Improve Forever combat map interactions and quest-sidebar layout, including resizing and restoring the saved window size.
- Restore the visible button for returning from fullscreen to the movable map.
- Make map diagnostics copyable when supported by the installed PatchTools version.

Validation: automated Classic Era/Forever integration checks in three locales, catalog checks and deferred marker-input tests pass. The maintainer tested the current Forever map in normal gameplay without further errors. Terrain/minimap detail views are not part of this release.

releases.name: PatchToolsMaps 0.3.3
releases.notes:
# PatchToolsMaps 0.3.3 — 2026-11-06

- Restore semi-transparent fog and full reveal on Forever build 70790, including Duskwood.
- Add map data verified against the current Blizzard client while preserving support for the previously covered builds.
- Keep actual exploration progress unchanged.

Validation: all automated integration and catalog checks pass. Duskwood reveal modes were confirmed in the live Forever client. The previously reported combat-layout and quest-marker taint cases remain under investigation.

releases.name: PatchToolsMaps 0.3.2
releases.notes:
# 0.3.2

- Improved Forever map proportions with the quest sidebar expanded or collapsed.
- Rebuilds the map viewport after opening and sidebar changes to reduce stale zoom and offset issues.
- Keeps the full extended zoom range available on both supported clients.
- Added optional scroll-state diagnostics: `/ptmaps taint` toggles tracing and `/ptmaps status` prints the result.

The reported Forever combat-layout and quest-marker taint issues remain under investigation. This release does not claim a confirmed fix for every combat case.

releases.name: PatchToolsMaps 0.3.1
releases.notes:
# PatchToolsMaps 0.3.1 — 2026-11-05

- Bring the modern map frame to Forever, including movement, resizing and the classic-frame option.
- Integrate Forever's map navigation and quest panel into the compact layout.
- Keep Blizzard's filter and quest-panel controls beside the map rather than among addon buttons.
- Improve quest-text contrast, keep quest action buttons inside the window and match the quest-list border.
- Avoid duplicate coordinate displays and restore the native layout when switching back.
- Fix native map-control ownership so opening the map no longer interrupts its initialization.

Validation: the Forever layout and quest details were checked in game. Automated Classic Era/Forever layout, restoration, interaction and map-catalog checks pass.

releases.name: PatchToolsMaps 0.3.0
releases.notes:
# PatchToolsMaps 0.3.0 — 2026-10-27

The modern Classic Era map is now part of the regular release.

- A compact modern frame with addon buttons, player/cursor coordinates and zone-specific Nova World Buffs timers outside the map.
- A toolbar toggle for Deathlog's heatmap, keeping the map itself clear.
- Keep the classic frame available as an option; Forever retains its native layout.
- Share map transparency between frames, with quick access by right-clicking the zone name.
- Save window position and size per character, and improve scaling, mouse hit areas and minimum-zoom stability.
- Zoom, move and resize during combat on unprotected Classic Era maps. Protected operations and frame-style changes wait until combat ends.
- Restore unexplored-area display choices for Classic Era build 70576.
- `/ptmaps debug` opens the shared support report with the matching PatchTools update.

Requires PatchTools. Recommended companion: PatchTools 0.9.0.

Validation: Classic Era gameplay testing by the maintainer and testers, plus automated Era/Forever checks. Forever's separate native layout remains in use; live Forever testing remains pending.
